$description: Cockpit grid. Width classes are measured on the cockpit container in Mission Control and on the window or viewport on Android and the agent cockpit. A kiosk surface is always tv.

time_to_reserve.short_when: the bar is short of room

zones.settings: the Menu button: navigation to every other screen and the settings live behind it

stop.visible: fully inside the viewport at every class, never scrolled or clipped

overflow.to_menu_note: when the row runs out of room, items move into the Menu lowest priority first in this order; link_text is the link's text, link_icon its icon
overflow.pill_when_short: the status pill truncates with an ellipsis once every movable item is in the Menu

chip.note: the chip never takes more than max_frac of the bar width; the full text shows in its tooltip or on tap (chip.full_text)

link.detail: RSSI and link quality live in the link popover (cockpit.link.rssi)

labels.note: icon with its short label under it; the full label stays the accessible name

zones.drop_note: when the column is too short, items leave it in this order

zones.note: the top-centre overlay stack; tips never cover it

zones.clean: a clean camera view: reticle, heading and horizon marks, AR route and detection boxes; the instruments draw only at the instruments level

text.top_alert: the newest alert's text when exactly one alert is active

status_pill.fc_status_text_note: MAVLink severity 4 (WARNING) or more severe (lower number)
status_pill.storage_note: percent of on-board storage used: warning at or above storage_warn_pct, critical at or above storage_crit_pct
status_pill.pilot_rule: a pilot state absent or older than flight-state.json stale_after_ms is a warning item alert.pilot_not_answering (source pilot), and its readiness and statustext items are dropped; the pill never reads OK without a fresh pilot state
status_pill.link_rule: the agent unreachable is a critical link item alert.agent_unreachable
status_pill.controller_rule: hold_reason controller-lost while armed and airborne is a warning item alert.controller_lost (source controller)
status_pill.preflight_rule: on the ground, every failing pre-flight checklist item is a warning item alert.preflight_failing (source preflight)

battery.low_fallback_note: the low-battery threshold when the flight controller reports none

holds_note: every confirm hold reads its duration here; fly_here keeps the value the agent cockpit and Android already use
map_long_press_note: a press held this long without moving on any map (card, full map, split pane) picks a point; right-click does the same with a mouse

menu.overflow_note: overflow lists only the top-bar items actually hidden; setup shows only when setup is needed; the kiosk has no exit

orientation_lock_note: browsers keep the portrait class; Home, Settings and Planner on Android still rotate
legacy_chrome_rule: the flight screen draws no status band, no telemetry strip, no navigation rail and no hint bar; controller button hints appear only inside sheets and menus while a gamepad is active

banners.severity_note: both countdowns end in an automatic manoeuvre; colours from tokens.json chrome.severity_<level>

sheets.close_button: inside the sheet header, below the top bar
sheets.note: sheets, dialogs and scrims on the flight screen start below the top bar, so STOP takes the first press with any sheet open
